com.plexapp.agents.fanarttv.text:
Fanart.tv is a community driven website providing fanart for TV shows, movies and artists.
Have some fanart to share? Visit fanart.tv

com.plexapp.agents.htbackdrops.text: High quality backdrops and wallpapers from Home Theater Backdrops for use in HTPC software.

com.plexapp.agents.movieposterdb.text:
The main purpose of the CineMaterial.com website
is to provide a database with movie posters that is as
complete as possible. All movie posters are free to download.

com.plexapp.agents.imdb.text:
Primary metadata provided by IMDb
Additional metadata provided by The Movie Database, a free and open movie database.
Video previews provided by Internet Video Archive
Other content from Wikipedia, licensed under the GFDL ChapterDB.org

com.plexapp.agents.themoviedb.text:
The Movie Database is a free and open movie database.
It's completely user driven by people like you.
The Movie Database is currently used by millions of people every month.

com.plexapp.agents.thetvdb.text:
TheTVDB.com is a community driven database of television shows.
It is our aim to be the most complete and accurate source of
information on TV series from many languages and countries.
